# Q8Block — Kuwait Local SEO Agency

> Q8Block is Kuwait's local SEO agency. We build and rank local websites that generate real calls for businesses in Kuwait.

## About

Q8Block (Kuwait Block — شركة كويت بلوك) helps Kuwaiti businesses reach Page 1 of Google through local SEO: keyword strategy, content, backlinks, and Google Business Profile management.

## Services

- Local SEO (on-page, technical, content)
- Google Business Profile setup and management
- Keyword research and tracking
- Backlink building
- Monthly ranking reports
- Website build, hosting, and maintenance

## Pricing

Monthly plans from KD 50 to KD 500. Includes blog posts, keyword tracking, and backlinks scaled to plan level. 6-month money-back guarantee.
